device.description: 8-bit 20-100 MSPS pipelined ADC with parallel CMOS outputs and power-down
device.note: adc08100.pdf (SNAS060I) p.1 pin configuration, p.2-3 pin descriptions, p.4 operating ratings, p.6-7 digital I/O and AC characteristics (tOD, pipeline delay), p.15 functional description (straight binary, PD), p.18 digital input pins

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2-3 (pin descriptions), p.4 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-3.6 V, DR VD 2.4 V to VA), p.6 (CLK/PD VIH/VIL), p.7 (tOD 5.9/8.5 ns, latency 2.5 clocks, 20-100 MHz), p.15 (straight binary, PD high = power down, outputs hold), p.18 (PD and clock pins)
notModeled: analog input and reference ladder (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
pipeline latency of 2.5 clock cycles (the code is constant); sampling on CLK falling, output valid tOD after CLK rising
clock frequency limits (20-125 MHz) and the ~1 us recovery after the clock restarts or PD goes low
outputs hold the last code while the clock is stopped or PD is high (the model's powerdown pin only blocks conversions)
CLK and PD are referenced to VA (2.7-3.6 V), the outputs to DR VD (2.4 V to VA); vcc is the DR VD range
variants: same pinout and digital interface as ADC08060 (adc08060.pdf)
